subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding the conceptual foundation of limits as a value a function approaches
source_inspiration: adapted from Japan MEXT Courses of Study sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student evaluates a function at values getting progressively closer to a target x-value to observe the approached value
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a graph's behavior near a point to its correct limit value
exercise.abstract: Student states the limit of a simple function as x approaches a given value, using a table or graph

misconception_flags: confuses the function's value AT a point with its limit approaching that point, when they differ

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
